blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala faces Wang Xiyu of China in the Asian Games women’s singles semifinal on Thursday at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. The Filipino tennis ace returns to the Center Court again, eyeing a spot in the gold medal match, which will put her closer to her Olympic dream for Los Angeles 2028. Eala faces her toughest opponent yet in Aichi-Nagoya in Wang, who is currently ranked No. 85 with a career-best ranking of No. 49. The two have not previously met on the court.
